newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: First Austrian to buy Bank Austria stake in Giro.
newsitem.headline: First Austrian to buy Bank Austria stake in Giro.

text.p: First Austrian Bank on Wednesday struck a deal with Bank Austria to buy its 56 percent stake in Girocredit Bank AG der Sparkassen.
The stake is currently owned by AVZ (Anteilsverwaltung Zentralsparkasse), and controlled by the City of Vienna which also controls Bank Austria.

"The board of First Austrian Savings Bank AG announces that it has reached a provisional agreement with Bank Austria regarding the sale of the stake in Girocredit Bank AG der Sparkassen GZWVp.VI, held by AVZ," a statement said.
The board of First Austrian is scheduled to discuss the agreement on March 19, following the expected approval by AVZ's supervisory board of the deal.
The sale of Girocredit's stake in AVZ was stipulated as part of the deal when Bank Austria took over the government's 70 percent stake in flagship bank Creditanstalt.
